claims.text: Porous wood scaffolds loaded with magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles have been used for lightweight EMI shielding.
Conductive wood has been developed as a structural EMI shielding material with a load-bearing function.
You have published bio-based magnetic and conductive wood for EMI shielding.
